name: Disaster Response Agent
description: AI-powered A2A disaster response planning agent that turns situation descriptions such as tornado, flood, wildfire, war, explosion, chemical hazard, or armed threat into detailed immediate-action guidance, shelter and evacuation steps, supplies, communications, and safety checklists. It can also discover other ADS agents and request support from them when useful.

skills.name: Build Disaster Response Plan
skills.description: Use an AI model to create a detailed emergency response plan from a situation description, including immediate actions, shelter guidance, evacuation guidance, communications, supplies, follow-up checks, and optional support from other ADS agents.
examples: A tornado warning was issued and people are in a classroom.
Flood water is entering the first floor and residents need instructions.
There are armed people near the building and staff need immediate guidance.

skills.name: Triage Disaster Situation
skills.description: Use an AI model to identify likely incident type, risk level, immediate hazards, first actions people should take, and whether another ADS agent may be useful.
examples: Classify this emergency: people heard shots outside.
What should people do first if a chemical smell enters the building?

skills.name: Create Disaster Checklist
skills.description: Use an AI model to generate an actionable checklist for shelter, evacuation, supplies, communications, medical needs, avoided actions, and coordination tasks for other ADS agents when relevant.
examples: Make a response checklist for a wildfire evacuation.
Create a tornado shelter checklist for a lab building.
